content: VERIFIED from official docs (better-auth.com next-auth-migration-guide, adapters/drizzle, concepts/session-management; fetched 2026-09-08): field mappings provider to providerId, providerAccountId to accountId, sessionToken to token, expires to expiresAt, emailVerified Date to BOOLEAN. Passwords must move from user rows into account rows with providerId credential and accountId equal to user id, else password sign-ins fail. Drizzle adapter accepts schema remapping (user: schema.users, modelName, fields mapping) and usePlural; schemaName for pg namespaces. cookieCache config session.cookieCache {enabled, maxAge in seconds e.g. 300, strategy compact|jwt|jwe}; revoked sessions may remain active until cache expires; bumping cookieCache.version invalidates all cached sessions; default expiresIn 7 days, updateAge 1 day, freshAge 1 day.
